newsitem.title: USA: Gillette in deal for Duracell -sources.
newsitem.headline: Gillette in deal for Duracell -sources.

text.p: Consumer products manufacturer Gillette Co. and battery maker Duracell International Inc. are expected to announce a $7 billion stock merger soon, sources familiar with the situation said Thursday.
The deal, which could be announced ahead of the stock market opening, values Duracell's stock at 0.904 share of Gillette, or $58.85 per share, the sources said.
Duracell's stock soared $6.125 to $54.50 in pre-opening trading, while Gillette fell $2 to $63.
Duracell and Gillette officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
Duracell's largest shareholder is buyout firm Kohlberg, Kravis Roberts and Co.
